notes.title: Small new patch
notes.content: We've just put live a patch that fixes one error that freezes the game, and a couple of other small issues like being able to comment on the firebird if you haven't seen it. As always, let us know if these issues persist for you, or if you find anything else.

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content: Celebrating Steam Visual Novel Fest with a new patch! Version 1.6 fixes some typos and late-game blank screen errors and, for the completionists among you, lowers the difficulty of the Glimmer of Hope achievement slightly. (Now you have no excuse!)

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Our latest small bug fix addresses blank screen errors in chapters 1 and 5, as well as eliminating floating-point errors that can cause the background to flicker when the game has been running for an extended period of time.

Thanks to everyone who played our demo at MAGWest!

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content: We released a teeny new patch today that fixes a bug where you're unable to tell Mila your backstory at the beginning of Chapter 7. We've also streamlined a few of the achievements to make them slightly simpler and verified that all achievements can be accessed in the current build. You can save Zvezdana, we promise! It's tough but it's possible!

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content: Our newest update is a small bug fix resolving some incorrect redirects and other minor issues. Please get in touch if you discover any continuing issues.

notes.title: Patch 2 Released
notes.content:
Our second and (hopefully) final patch has been released. This patch includes fixes for all (yep, count 'em, all) known bugs reported by players!

This patch also adds Mac and Linux builds, as well as full SteamDeck support. We are grateful to the players who helped us test these builds. The demo now features support for all platforms as well.

Additional new features include a game log, fixes to scaling issues for unusual display resolutions, and graphical improvements. We've also reduced the difficulty of some hard-to-find game branches to help you conquer those tricky alternate endings.

This is considered our final, definitive release. However, we'll still be listening to player feedback and will continue to patch any additional bugs that may arise.

notes.title: First patch released
notes.content:
The Nightwell Forge is proud to announce that The Wolf of Derevnya v1.1 is out now! This new release includes many features that didn't make it into the initial release, including:

-Full save system with multiple slots
-Game log
-Toggle to turn off the screen flicker
-Fullscreen and windowed mode
-The options causing blank page errors have been removed (we're still looking into the cause of this error)
-Consolidated to about 100mb smaller
-And best of all, 26 achievements!

Achievements are not retroactive (sorry) but your legacy save game should gracefully appear in the first save slot. If it doesn't, notify the Ravenmaster and the Nightwell Beasts will tackle the problem post-haste.

For our future roadmap, our second patch will port to Mac, Linux, and SteamDeck, and we're hoping to have that out by the end of May.
